items.title: Upstream win: cfgpack MessagePack int64 UBSan — fixed in b5e7cff
items.summary: HackMe Tier-D fuzz caught signed integer overflow in cfgpack_msgpack_decode_int64(). We reported cfgpack#1; maintainer @Arsievert merged fix b5e7cff. Not a CVE — real UB hardening before memory bugs ship.
items.impact: Proof that oss_cve hunts land upstream: report → fix in days, no drama, no fake CVE. ASAN saw no heap corruption; UBSan did its job. Case study live on hackme.tech/reports/oss-cve/cases/cfgpack.html

telegram.headline: Upstream fix — cfgpack int64 UBSan
telegram.lead: Reported #1 · fixed b5e7cff · not CVE · real win
bullets: HackMe fuzz: MessagePack 0xd3 path → signed shift overflow msgpack.c:294
Maintainer closed issue completed — patch merged
No ASAN heap bug — UB hardening, exactly what Tier-D is for
Case study: hackme.tech/reports/oss-cve/cases/cfgpack.html
telegram.footer: OSS CVE hub: hackme.tech/reports/oss-cve/ · methodology on GitHub

thread: We don't only chase CVE numbers. Sometimes the win is simpler: find UB, report it, upstream ships a fix.
cfgpack (MessagePack decoder): our Tier-D fuzz hit cfgpack_msgpack_decode_int64() with a malformed 0xd3 payload. UBSan: signed left-shift overflow at msgpack.c:294.
Reported → github.com/Arsievert/cfgpack/issues/1. Maintainer @Arsievert closed it completed with fix b5e7cff.
Not CVE-class: no ASAN heap corruption. This is the kind of hardening that prevents worse bugs later.
Full case study → https://hackme.tech/reports/oss-cve/cases/cfgpack.html
twitter.single: HackMe fuzz → cfgpack int64 UBSan reported → upstream fixed in b5e7cff. Not a CVE. A real disclosure win. https://hackme.tech/reports/oss-cve/cases/cfgpack.html

discord.title: Research · cfgpack fixed upstream
discord.body:
**Not every hunt ends in a CVE — this one ended better: a merged fix.**

**What we found**
• MessagePack `int64` decode (`0xd3`) — UBSan signed overflow in `cfgpack_msgpack_decode_int64()`
• Tier-D mutation fuzz · wave2 · clang ASAN/UBSan

**What happened**
• Reported [cfgpack#1](https://github.com/Arsievert/cfgpack/issues/1)
• Maintainer fix: [b5e7cff](https://github.com/Arsievert/cfgpack/commit/b5e7cff)
• No CVE — no heap corruption demonstrated

**Read:** https://hackme.tech/reports/oss-cve/cases/cfgpack.html
